tasks.bench: deno task prep && deno bench --allow-all --no-check benchmarks/
tasks.bench:pg: deno task prep && DISC_PG_AUTO=1 deno bench --allow-all --no-check benchmarks/
tasks.build: deno task prep && deno run --allow-all --no-check cli/main.ts build
tasks.build:darwin-arm64: deno task prep && deno run --allow-all --no-check cli/main.ts build --platform darwin-arm64
tasks.build:darwin-x64: deno task prep && deno run --allow-all --no-check cli/main.ts build --platform darwin-x64
tasks.build:linux-arm64: deno task prep && deno run --allow-all --no-check cli/main.ts build --platform linux-arm64
tasks.build:linux-x64: deno task prep && deno run --allow-all --no-check cli/main.ts build --platform linux-x64
tasks.check: deno task prep && deno task lint && deno task format --check && deno task test
tasks.cli: deno task prep && deno run --allow-all --no-check cli/main.ts
tasks.dev: deno task prep && deno run --watch --allow-all --no-check cli/main.ts
tasks.serve: deno task prep && deno run --allow-net --allow-read --allow-env server/server.ts
tasks.test:all: deno task prep && DISC_PG_AUTO=1 deno test --allow-all --no-check --ignore=ui/
tasks.test:pg: deno task prep && DISC_PG_AUTO=1 deno test --allow-all --no-check --ignore=ui/
